note: The Manipur State Congress Party merged back into the Indian National Congress with its five MLAs.
Socialist Janata (Democratic), the Kerala party of M. P. Veerendra Kumar, merged into the Janata Dal (United).
Jitan Ram Manjhi left the Janata Dal (United) with 18 others and launched the Hindustani Awam Morcha.
Manpreet Singh Badal merged the People's Party of Punjab into the Indian National Congress.
Francis George, Antony Raju and others left Kerala Congress (M) and formed the Janadhipathya Kerala Congress.
Kuldeep Bishnoi merged the Haryana Janhit Congress (BL) into the Indian National Congress.
Anupriya Patel's breakaway from Apna Dal founded Apna Dal (Soneylal); Krishna Patel's faction kept the Apna Dal name.
The Quami Ekta Dal merged into the Bahujan Samaj Party (an earlier merger into the Samajwadi Party in June 2016 was cancelled).
T. T. V. Dhinakaran, expelled from the AIADMK, launched the Amma Makkal Munnetra Kazhagam; the AIADMK kept its name and symbol.
Sharad Yadav's faction of the Janata Dal (United) formed the Loktantrik Janata Dal; the Kerala JD(U) unit of M. P. Veerendra Kumar joined it in 2018.
Shivpal Singh Yadav left the Samajwadi Party and founded the Pragatisheel Samajwadi Party (Lohiya).
The Jai Bharat Samanta Party of Geeta Koda merged into the Indian National Congress.
Dushyant Chautala, expelled from the INLD, launched the Jannayak Janta Party; the INLD kept its name and symbol.
Babulal Marandi merged the Jharkhand Vikas Morcha (Prajatantrik) into the Bharatiya Janata Party.
The Election Commission awarded the Kerala Congress (M) name and symbol to the Jose K. Mani faction; P. J. Joseph's faction contests as Kerala Congress.
Upendra Kushwaha merged the Rashtriya Lok Samta Party into the Janata Dal (United).
The Election Commission froze the Lok Janshakti Party name and symbol and allotted new names to both factions; Chirag Paswan's LJP (Ram Vilas) is treated as the successor.
Pashupati Kumar Paras's faction of the Lok Janshakti Party was allotted the name Rashtriya Lok Janshakti Party.
Sharad Yadav merged the Loktantrik Janata Dal into the Rashtriya Janata Dal; the Kerala unit followed on 12 October 2023.
Amarinder Singh merged the Punjab Lok Congress into the Bharatiya Janata Party.
The Election Commission allotted Uddhav Thackeray's faction the name Shiv Sena (Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray); the Shiv Sena name and symbol went to Eknath Shinde's faction on 17 February 2023.
Shivpal Singh Yadav merged the Pragatisheel Samajwadi Party (Lohiya) back into the Samajwadi Party.
Upendra Kushwaha left the Janata Dal (United) and formed the Rashtriya Lok Janata Dal, renamed Rashtriya Lok Morcha on 18 February 2024.
P. C. George merged the Kerala Janapaksham (Secular) into the Bharatiya Janata Party.
The Election Commission awarded the Nationalist Congress Party name and symbol to Ajit Pawar's faction and named Sharad Pawar's faction Nationalist Congress Party (Sharadchandra Pawar).
Sukhdev Singh Dhindsa merged the Shiromani Akali Dal (Sanyukt) back into the Shiromani Akali Dal.
Pappu Yadav merged the Jan Adhikar Party (Loktantrik) into the Indian National Congress.
The Marxist Co-ordination Committee of Jharkhand merged into the CPI(ML) Liberation.
Founded on 4 February 2013 by P. S. Golay, an SDF minister who had broken with Pawan Chamling.
Chiranjeevi's Praja Rajyam Party merged into the Indian National Congress.
Founded in 2011 and led by Y. S. Jagan Mohan Reddy after he left the Congress.
